_meta.note: PLACEHOLDER CONTENT for OO — copied from SGH. Copy, images and translations are still the SGH ones; replace them before the variant ships. Every string is an object keyed by locale, resolved at runtime by getTrad() (src/js/modules/utils.js), which falls back country -> language -> prefix -> en-us -> en. "image" is a path relative to the environment image path (package.json > projectConfigurations.paths), prefixed by contents.js — those files must exist under src/static/images/OO/.
